title: Rivals Quick Start Set: card flavor text

entities.name: Mesa Pegasus
entities.description: A winged horse that legend says appears to blessed brides in Sursi, granting long life and good fortune.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A village where a woman must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus before she marries.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Aquatic people; human scholars think they descend from sunken Atlantis, while they believe humans descend from them.

entities.name: Atlantis
entities.description: A sunken land that human scholars believe Merfolk survivors came from.

entities.name: Raganorn
entities.description: A figure who unsealed catacombs and found more than the dead and their treasures.

entities.name: Cannelbrae
entities.description: Bogs where a mate met an early grave.

entities.name: Hel
entities.description: Realm with the Great Wall, where the bones of sinners wait for Ragnarok.

entities.name: Hela
entities.description: Figure who will call forth the bones of sinners for the final battle at Ragnarok.

entities.name: Ragnarok
entities.description: The final battle for which the bones of sinners wait in Hel.

entities.name: Ironclaw clan
entities.description: A clan of Orcs bred to be deviously cowardly.

entities.name: Mons
entities.description: Pashalik of the Rundvelt Goblins, who leads his Raiders like a thunderhead leading a storm.

entities.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
entities.description: The Raiders of Pashalik Mons, a Rundvelt Goblin band.

entities.name: Rundvelt
entities.description: Homeland of Goblins whose affairs are chaotic.

entities.name: Dominia
entities.description: The world of Grizzly Bears dangerous to those who flee.

entities.name: Scryb
entities.description: Sprites and Faeries who drove off intruders with the clicking of their wings.

entities.name: Mi'cha
entities.description: A figure who flung a drunken soldier over ten meters, apparently with a War Mammoth.

entities.name: Orcs
entities.description: Brutish people who invented a destructive artillery weapon.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A figure whose defeat taught mages not to rely heavily on walls.

entities.name: D'Avenant
entities.description: People whose proverb says healing is a matter of time and opportunity.

events.summary: A D'Avenant proverb says healing depends on time and opportunity.
events.quote: "Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity."

events.summary: Legend holds a Mesa Pegasus appears to a pure-hearted bride in Sursi, blessing her family.
events.quote: Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear

events.summary: Raganorn unsealed the catacombs and found Murk Dwellers.
events.quote: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

events.summary: Mishra's defeat taught mages not to rely on walls.
events.quote: By the time Mishra was defeated, no mage was foolish enough to rely heavily on walls.

events.summary: Mi'cha flung a drunken soldier over ten meters.
events.quote: His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

events.summary: Orcs invented a destructive weapon, and critics became its artillerists.
events.quote: Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

events.summary: The Scryb Faeries drove off intruders.
events.quote: Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled.

relations.quote: Pashalik Mons and his Raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

relations.note: Hela will call forth the bones for the final battle
relations.quote: when Hela will call them forth for the final battle
The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy.
